fonts.display: 'PP Neue Montreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'PP Neue Montreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Vellum Sand
palette.role: Primary page canvas — the base warm-cream that fills every section, never competing with content

palette.name: Pressed Linen
palette.role: Secondary surface for subtle section breaks, link backgrounds, and content cards resting on Vellum Sand

palette.name: Aged Ink
palette.role: Dominant text and hairline border color — near-black with a touch of warmth, used for 95% of all rules, headings, and body copy

palette.name: Charcoal Black
palette.role: Hard ink for display headings, icon fills, and the strongest contrast moments where absolute black reads better than warm

palette.name: Twilight Bronze
palette.role: Gradient stop — the deepest tone in the vertical vellum wash, used only inside the hero gradient

palette.name: Hayfield
palette.role: Gradient midtone — the saturated middle of the vertical wash, gives the canvas its sun-warmed depth

palette.name: Wheat Sheaf
palette.role: Gradient light tone — the transition stop between the warm mid and the Vellum base
